name: qPCR fold change
subtitle: ΔΔCt method, relative to GAPDH
what_it_does: Leaves out failed wells: no signal, or a Ct of 35 or above.
Averages the three repeat wells for each sample and gene.
Compares each gene with GAPDH in the same sample.
Compares each sample with the average control sample.
Reports fold change: 2.00 means twice as much as in control.

how_it_was_made.check: Sofie read each step against the Excel template
Anders compared it with three past plates
plain code, the same every time
